protocol.train_reward: exact match of all answer digits
protocol.eval: greedy exact match by bucket; evaluated every fixed number of received groups, timed at the second consecutive post-initial hit at distinct update counts
protocol.wall_clock: actor startup, training, periodic and final eval, trace writes; initial eval untimed
protocol.arms: recompute: per-completion prompt prefill and suffix-only dense learner scoring; share_prompt: actor prefill and differentiable learner prefix reuse; both use FIFO
protocol.swap_check: every four generated tokens, outside the three-token rollout horizon
protocol.training_clock: all actors ready and released through a start gate, through evaluation
protocol.accuracy_metric: all: exact match of every answer digit
